units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Comparing Two Things · grammar (差不多 + 一样 + adjective)
units.source: "差不多一样" combines "almost" with "the same" for a hedge - "about the same/roughly equal".
units.translation: "差不多一样" combina "casi" con "igual" para suavizar la afirmación: "más o menos igual/aproximadamente igual".

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Comparing Two Things · grammar (差不多 + 一样 + adjective)
units.source: Using 一样 alone when you mean "roughly" equal rather than "exactly" equal - 差不多 adds the needed hedge.
units.translation: Usar 一样 solo cuando se quiere decir "aproximadamente" igual en vez de "exactamente" igual: 差不多 agrega el matiz necesario.

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Comparing Two Things · grammar (A + 没有 + B + 那么 + adjective + 吧)

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Comparing Two Things · grammar (A + 没有 + B + 那么 + adjective + 吧)
units.source: Adding 吧 at the end of a 没有...那么 comparison turns it into a tentative guess rather than a firm claim.

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Comparing Two Things · grammar (A + 没有 + B + 那么 + adjective + 吧)
units.source: Dropping 吧 when a softer, questioning tone is intended - without it the statement sounds too certain.

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Giving Reasons · grammar (因为 + reason, 所以 + result)
units.source: Explain the reason behind an opinion or choice
units.translation: Explicar la razón detrás de una opinión o una elección

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Giving Reasons · grammar (因为 + reason, 所以 + result)
units.source: "因为...所以" ("because...so") gives a full cause-and-effect explanation, both halves usually present in formal explanation.
units.translation: "因为...所以" ("porque...así que") da una explicación completa de causa y efecto; en una explicación formal suelen aparecer las dos partes.

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Giving Reasons · grammar (因为 + reason, 所以 + result)
units.source: Using only 因为 or only 所以 alone when explaining reasoning in writing - using both together is the standard, complete pattern.
units.translation: Usar solo 因为 o solo 所以 al explicar un razonamiento por escrito: usar ambos juntos es el patrón estándar y completo.

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Giving Reasons · grammar (虽然 + concession, 但是 + contrasting point)
units.source: Acknowledge a point while still adding a contrasting one
units.translation: Reconocer un punto y a la vez agregar uno contrastante

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Giving Reasons · grammar (虽然 + concession, 但是 + contrasting point)
units.source: "虽然...但是" ("although...but") first concedes a point, then adds a contrasting idea - great for nuanced opinions.
units.translation: "虽然...但是" ("aunque...pero") primero concede un punto y luego agrega una idea contrastante: ideal para opiniones matizadas.

units.context: Scenario: Opinions, Comparisons & Preferences · Lesson: Giving Reasons · grammar (虽然 + concession, 但是 + contrasting point)
units.source: Adding 可是 or 不过 in addition to 但是 in the same sentence - only one contrast word is needed after 虽然.
units.translation: Agregar 可是 o 不过 además de 但是 en la misma oración: después de 虽然 solo se necesita una palabra de contraste.
